en-GB.summary: Play shows, films, YouTube and live channels on your TV with LUMEN.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Plexodus to put BBC One on
en-GB.name: LUMEN Voice
en-GB.description: Control your TV by voice with LUMEN. Shows and films play in Plexodus and pick up where you left off, "on YouTube" plays on YouTube, and channel names tune LUMEN. Pair your TV in LUMEN's Settings, Alexa.
